notes.title: Dev Update #2 - Adding Small Maps and More
notes.content:
Hey everyone,



We're back with another exciting update!



This time, we've added small variants for all three current maps, giving each one a fresh twist. We've also introduced a new lobby settings menu, allowing you to choose exactly which gamemodes and maps you want to play.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579200/f97d8f2882346aac105e14bb8c53b887acac4571.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579200/670391676cafc895c95c37b199e75dddd21fd0b1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579200/77dd704f8107e744649f5c5bfa7a7f03852b37d4.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579200/27f9a9ed93b5cdfd574653035ec8437c0b1b8ea8.png"]

On top of that, there's now a pregame screen that shows key information about the upcoming round and explains the rules of the gamemode you're about to play, so everyone’s on the same page before the chaos begins!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579200/75aabfb13ff3236e798651460848c05f2bc6201c.png"]

And there's more on the way! Our next update will bring local multiplayer and full controller support, so stay tuned!

— The Chunky Pixel Games Team

notes.title: Dev Update #1 - Adding Menus and UI
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve added the first batch of in-game menus to Buckle Up! along with animations to bring them to life. It’s a big step toward making the game feel complete. More UI improvements are coming soon, so stay tuned!
